summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K reporting August 2026 trading by management and related persons under Article 11 of CVM Resolution 44/2021. The consolidated form shows no transactions by board members or management during the month, while group/controlling-shareholder and management-related positions are disclosed, including common and Class A preferred shares and structured transaction certificates. Opening and closing balances largely match, indicating no material change in holdings. No corporate action, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure with no deal terms and no arbitrage angle to monitor.
